name: createStaff
intent: Register an airport staff member's identity, contact details, role and reporting relationship.
the admin records their basic information
pre: The supplied staff identifier is not already assigned to a staff member.
post: A new staff member is created.
The new staff member has the supplied identifier.
The new staff member has the supplied name.
The new staff member's password is the supplied pswd value.
The new staff member has the supplied phone number.
The new staff member has the supplied role value.
If bossid identifies an existing staff member, that person is assigned as the new staff member's boss.
if bo.oclIsUndefined() = false then s.Boss = bo endif
The new staff member is stored in the system's staff records.
difficulty_basis: Creation, five field initializations and a conditional reporting relationship.
scenarios: Confirms stored staff and fields. The additional undefined-boss assertion relies on initialization behavior, not an explicit else obligation in the reference.
Existing boss is linked and result is true.
conflicts: Jest requires an undefined boss for an unknown bossid; the reference only specifies the existing-boss branch. No missing-boss postcondition was invented.
description_audit: KEEP + NORMALIZE; retain optional boss semantics without inventing a required boss or a role whitelist.
reference_audit: All asserted NL obligations map to exact local clauses. Missing-boss initialization is left for review.
effects_audit: New staff, individual attributes, conditional boss association, storage and true return are covered. No else effect is inferred.
